notes.title: New DEMO released! Play now! :D
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We hope you're doing well.

We have been working a lot on polishing Fairy Rescue and some improvements on Strip Battle too.
Today we have launched a new DEMO for Fairy Rescue, feel free to take a look at it here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3254900/Fairy_Rescue/

Some of the improvements:
[list]
[*]Total gameplay rework of the first level
[*]New attack patterns for the Boss and smaller enemies
[*]Adding Gallery where you can check the rescued girls
[*]Story improved
[*]Play Nudist Mode (1-hit kill) to unlock extra pictures for the Gallery
[/list]

We plan to release Fairy Rescue in the next few months, we hope you guys are excited!

Cheers,
Disrobia Team
